body:
## Summary
test_map decides what `--changed` (and tools/mutate) runs by plain text mention. It sends 57% of real project-touching commits to the FULL suite, and on the other 43% it misses the tests of the changed file's direct dependents. Replace the mention check with a derived reach index built from res:// literals (including directory constants), class_name and autoload names, plus one dependent hop.

## Description
New `tools/tests/reach_index.mjs` builds, in one pass (~3 s, zero-dep), a reverse index over project/{boot,core,features,dev}: the files each res:// literal names (the exact path, else the nearest ancestor-directory literal), and class_name/autoload name -> declaring file. `mapChanges` keeps its signature and adds these rules: a non-.gd file maps through the scripts/scenes that reference it to their tests; a .gd maps to its direct tests plus the direct tests of its one-hop dependents; dev/** with no mentioning test maps to nothing (layers lint guarantees shipped code never reaches dev); tests/scenarios|golden|parity map to no unit tests; support/schemas/project.godot/addons stay FULL; an unreferenced asset stays FULL. Full transitive closure was measured and rejected: 563 of 611 shipped files reach >= 80% of the suite through the composition root. `--why` prints the chain for one test; `--history=N` replays git history through the map, so the claim stays measurable.

## Flow
- agent edits a png, a table row or a dev bench file and runs `run_unit --changed`
- today: 'FULL suite: ...: no test mentions it', ~50 s of GUT on every fast file
- after: the scripts that load it -> their tests, plus a note naming the reach; `--why` explains any pick
- tools/mutate picks the same, better-scoped tests automatically

## Expected impact
FULL fallbacks drop from 57% to 24% of commits touching project/. Mean files selected drops 200 -> 94, even with the one-hop safety added. Each FULL avoided saves ~50 s of GUT (the last full gut step: 53.5 s). The one-hop rule closes a measured under-selection where `--changed` stays green and the full gate goes red.

## Evaluation
Claim: reach-aware mapping avoids most FULL fallbacks and stops missing the tests of direct dependents.
Before: last 600 non-merge commits, 157 touch project/ (non-.uid/.import/.md); current test_map sends 90 (57%) to FULL, mean 200.0 test files per commit. 420 of the 473 directly mapped shipped .gd files have one-hop dependents whose tests are not selected (5,945 missed file edges). Example: core/clock/sim_loop.gd -> 1 test while 7 source files use SimLoop.
After: same replay with the rules simulated: 38 FULL (24%), mean 94.3 files, 6 commits correctly need 0 unit tests (dev-only).
Method: simulation - scratch probe sim.mjs imports the real mapChanges/realIndex and replays `git log --no-merges -n 600 --name-only` through the current and the proposed rules on the current tree index.
Result: better
Gate: architecture
evidence: Probe output (scratchpad/probe/sim.mjs): current {commits:157, full:90, pctFull:57, meanFiles:200.0} top reasons features/characters 27 (pngs), data/tables 14, features/vehicles 8, dev/bench 6, data/schemas 6; reach+1hop {full:38, pctFull:24, zero:6, meanFiles:94.3}. map2.mjs: 138/611 shipped .gd map FULL today (incl. core/save/save.gd, core/log/log.gd, core/world_system.gd); directMapped 473, missFiles 420, miss 5945 (top: core/data/data_table.gd 18 direct vs +151 via dependents; core/clock/sim_clock.gd 56 vs +142). Full transitive closure: 563/611 files >= 80% of 346 test files (rejected). CLI today: `node tools/tests/test_map.mjs project/data/tables/bosses.json` -> 'FULL suite: ... no test mentions it'; project/dev/bench/bench_driver.gd -> FULL; project/core/clock/sim_loop.gd -> 1 test (test_quest_objectives). Lane: docs/day/2026-11-07/city/JOURNAL.md:643 a table change ran 1504 tests via --changed's FULL fallback; docs/day/2026-11-06/chars/JOURNAL.md:450 'unit (full, via --changed: schema touched)'.

body:
## Summary
One module, tools/evidence/scope.mjs, decides which paths an evidence kind can possibly read. run.mjs uses it in the three places that today treat every path alike: the dirty-tree gate, the import-churn check, and a new carry step that re-stamps an existing envelope onto HEAD when nothing in scope changed since it was built.

## Description
The pipeline keys freshness on HEAD and refuses or fails on any porcelain line. But 60.6% of commits touch only docs/evidence (lane JOURNAL/REPORT, logs, stills), and lanes write logs into evidence/ while a run is going. So an inert JOURNAL edit fails unit-tests evidence, an untracked PNG refuses the run, and a REPORT commit after a 13-minute green run stales all seven envelopes. Today the inert set is a belief kept in prose ("scratch output goes to build/ while it runs, and no tracked edits during it"). This card makes it a declared rule (docs/**, evidence/**, root JOURNAL.md and REPORT.md), plus a guard test that fails if any evidence kind's tool starts reading those roots. Carry only re-stamps `commit` to HEAD, whose in-scope tree is byte-identical, and appends a "carried from <sha>" summary suffix. builtAt, status, counts, metrics and artifacts are kept, so the pof.godot-evidence/1 shape and kind enum do not change. A failed envelope is carried as failed, so nothing is laundered. --fresh forces a full run.

## Flow
- run.mjs start: classify porcelain -> refuse only on code dirt; inert dirt is named in a summary suffix
- per kind: build/evidence/<kind>.json exists, its commit A is an ancestor of HEAD, godotVersion matches, git diff --name-only A HEAD is all inert -> carry (no Godot); otherwise run the kind
- unit churn: only code-path churn fails the kind
- the scope.test guard keeps the inert premise true as the tools evolve

## Expected impact
The end-of-session evidence re-run after a REPORT/JOURNAL commit drops from 7-13 min to seconds. The dirty-tree refusal over logs, PNGs and JOURNAL edits stops (4 lane reports cite it), and so does the false unit-tests FAIL on inert churn (13 committed logs). Lanes no longer need --allow-dirty (67 mentions in 18 lane docs), which today stamps a dirty note into every PoF summary.

## Evaluation
Claim: evidence freshness and dirt checks should follow what the kinds read, not raw HEAD/porcelain.
Before: 3343 of 5520 non-merge commits since 2026-11-02 (60.6%) touch only docs/, evidence/ or root JOURNAL/REPORT.md, and each one stales all 7 kinds. 13 committed evidence logs carry "tree changed during run", and every listed churn path is inert. --allow-dirty has 67 hits in 18 lane docs. A --no-bench run takes about 7-13 min.
After: 0 refusals or churn FAILs from inert paths. An evidence run whose diff from the last run is inert-only finishes in under 10 s with all kinds carried. Code dirt is still refused, as today.
Method: probe - classified git log --name-only over 5520 commits; ran git grep "tree changed during run" -- evidence; grepped every evidence tool for reads of docs/ or evidence/ and found none (tools/tests/save_crash.mjs only WRITES evidence/autosave and is not an evidence kind).
Result: better
Gate: contract
evidence: classification -> {commits:5520, inert:3343, pct:60.6}. git grep -l 'tree changed during run' -- evidence -> 13 files; churn tails: 'M JOURNAL.md' x3, 'M  JOURNAL.md' x2, 'M REPORT.md' x2, 'M REPORT.md, M docs/perf/LEDGER.md, ?? evidence/perf/l4b-bc7cv/bc7cv-import.patch.gz', 'M REPORT.md, M docs/ghosts/ghost-attacks.md', 'M JOURNAL.md, M REPORT.md, ?? evidence/n7-melee/scenarios-edb40f7c.log', '?? evidence/it11/padwalk/, ?? evidence/it12/padwalk2/'. grep -- --allow-dirty docs/*/*/*/{REPORT,JOURNAL}.md -> 18 files, 67 hits. Evidence tools that read docs/ or evidence/: none (tools/debt/metrics.mjs:52 reads justfile + AGENTS.md; tools/lint/lint.mjs:35-36 walks project/data and steam/).
coordinator_note: APPROVED WITHOUT CARRY: do not build carry.mjs, do not rewrite any envelope commit/builtAt, no --fresh flag. Build only scope.mjs + its use in the dirty-tree gate and the import-churn check, and the inert-readers guard. The excluded carry step is a cross-repo meaning change and stays on the backlog.

body:
## Summary
One Node front door for every dev scene or -s script: node tools/dev/run.mjs <entry> [flags]. Before launch it resolves the entry (scene or -s script) and puts the scene path and the -- where they belong. It checks each flag against the entry's declared spec, read statically from the .gd (card A's ArgSpec const, falling back to a KNOWN list const), and refuses a wrong one in under a second. It derives --fixed-fps/--quit-after from a declared RUN_TICKS. After exit it prints one verdict line built from the exit code, SCRIPT ERROR lines, unknown-arg warnings and whether the result file is fresh. tools/lib/dev_verdict.mjs is the same judgement as a library, and tools/selftest/run.mjs adopts it.

## Description
The users are the lanes that film A/B befores and afters many times an hour. Their most repeated loss on 2026-11-06/07 is a film of the wrong scene: arena flags passed without res://dev/arena/arena.tscn, or after a stray --, which boot.gd:10 only warns about. That is 8 FRICTION lines (chars 21/234/304, hud 50/165/1294, rivet 388/707), each a wasted run of minutes. The second is guessing --quit-after for reels whose length the script already knows (rivet 175, 602). The third is that no runner states the verdict: lanes grep their logs and write "0 SCRIPT ERROR, 0 unknown arg" into REPORTs by hand, and the selftest runner itself drops two exit statuses. This is not a flag registry: the tool reads each entry's own declaration at call time, and there is no list file, owner or expiry.

## Flow
- entries.mjs: resolve(name|path) -> {kind: scene|script, path, flags, runTicks}. A bare name searches project/dev/**/<name>.{tscn,gd}. Flags are parsed from the entry's const spec and its *_args.gd helper (e.g. boot/arena_args.gd).
- run.mjs: pre-flight first (an unknown flag exits 2 with a did-you-mean and nothing is spawned). It builds args through runGodot, so the ledger, the import preflight and the tree-kill still apply. Headless by default, --windowed opt-in; the log goes to build/dev/<entry>-<time>.log.
- dev_verdict.mjs: verdict({status, out, timedOut}, {resultFile, startedAt}) -> {ok, line, scriptErrors[], unknownArgs[]}. Exit codes read as 0 ok / 1 fail / 2 usage / -1 never ran, plus timeout.
- tools/selftest/run.mjs: runLookGolden, runAccentAudit, runWorldLock and runSelftest pass their result through verdict, so an exit 1 or a SCRIPT ERROR can no longer pass behind an ok JSON.
- reel_director.gd declares RUN_TICKS from its existing total, so the reel's --quit-after is derived.

## Expected impact
The wrong-scene film becomes a refused command before Godot starts. The reel length stops being a guess. Every dev run ends in one line a lane can paste into its REPORT, and selftest evidence stops passing on a failed exit.

## Evaluation
Claim: a pre-flight plus a single verdict line removes the lanes' most repeated dev-run loss and their hand-assembled verdicts.
Before: 8 wrong-scene/stray-separator FRICTION lines in 3 lanes over 2026-11-06/07 (chars x3, hud x3, rivet x2); 2 --quit-after-too-short lines (rivet 175, 602); hand-written "0 SCRIPT ERROR / 0 unknown arg" verdicts in the calls and held REPORTs; 2 of 4 selftest stages ignore the exit status; 2 of 10 runGodot callers scan for SCRIPT_ERROR.
After: each of those 8 commands exits 2 in under 1 s and names the scene or the flag; the reel's --quit-after is derived; one verdict line per run; all 4 selftest stages and every run.mjs launch judged by verdict.
Method: probe - grepped FRICTION lines in docs/day/2026-11-0{6,7}/*/JOURNAL.md, the REPORT verdict lines, SCRIPT_ERROR importers across tools/**/*.mjs and the awaits in tools/selftest/run.mjs.
Result: better
Gate: none

REPORTs: calls/REPORT.md:42,55,59,67,69,71 and held/REPORT.md:7,82 hand-write "0 SCRIPT ERROR"/"no unknown-arg warning". grep SCRIPT_ERROR tools: only run_unit.mjs:19 and perf/ab.mjs:18 import it, of 10 runGodot callers. tools/selftest/run.mjs:62 and :91 are bare awaits (no status read).

body:
## Summary
`node tools/evidence/cites.mjs <REPORT.md|decisions.md>...` pulls every backtick-cited path out of a lane report or a decision line. It expands braces and itN..itM ranges, checks file:line, and resolves declared root aliases (M/, masters/). Each miss prints with its line and a suggestion from the nearest tracked path. Lanes do this check by hand at the end of every session today.

## Description
PoF and the owner read the REPORT tables of `evidence/...` paths, which makes the cites as load-bearing as the gates. 20 of 50 lane reports spend a REPORT-phase step saying every path was re-checked by hand, and misses still ship: decisions.md:137 has cited a non-existent evidence/cop-gate.json since 2026-11-03. Someone found that by hand and it was never fixed. The tool gives each cite one status. OK. MISSING, with a basename-match suggestion over git ls-files. MISSING-LINE. UNTRACKED: on disk but not committed, so it dies with the worktree. PATTERN: a placeholder or glob. UNCHECKED: an undeclared root. It accepts one canonical header form `Paths: \`M/\` = \`<dir>\`` and also parses the prose variants already in the reports where it can.

## Flow
- extract `...` tokens starting with evidence/, project/, tools/, docs/, native/, frames/ or a declared alias
- expand {a,b} and itN..itM; split :L, :L,M and :L-M
- resolve; suggest by basename; print 'file:line path STATUS (hint)' + one summary line; exit 1 on MISSING/MISSING-LINE (+UNTRACKED with --tracked, +UNCHECKED with --strict)

## Expected impact
The REPORT-phase path re-check (20/50 reports) becomes one command that runs in under a second. Stale cites in decisions.md and the reports surface with the fix suggested, and untracked evidence is caught before its worktree is removed.

## Evaluation
Claim: lanes hand-verify cited evidence paths every session, and misses still ship.
Before: 20/50 REPORT.md describe a manual path re-check. A naive probe (backtick tokens under evidence|project|tools|docs|native, no expansion) over 51 docs (50 reports + decisions.md) finds 112 of 751 cites unresolved, worst n-d5 37 and n-noir 37 (mostly worktree-local untracked evidence, which the real tool separates out). Among them is the confirmed real miss at decisions.md:137.
After: one command per report, under 1 s. The cop-gate miss prints with 'did you mean evidence/d5-cast/cop-gate.json'. Range and brace false positives (held 'it1..it4', autosave 'patches/0001..0005') resolve.
Method: probe - a read-only node script over git ls-files docs/*REPORT.md + docs/decisions.md, existsSync per cite.
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: probe {files:51, tot:751, miss:112}; worst: n-d5 37, n-noir 37, human-reactions 12, visual-fixes 6, showcase 4, ranged 4. Samples: docs/decisions.md -> evidence/cop-gate.json (real miss; git ls-files | grep cop-gate -> evidence/d5-cast/cop-gate.json); docs/day/2026-11-05/held/REPORT.md -> evidence/held-it1..it4-reel-director.log (range); docs/day/2026-11-03/d5-cast/REPORT.md -> project/dev/showcase/d5_hero.gd:7,57 (multi-line cite). grep -liE 'every..path..checked|re-checked every path|path check' docs/*/*/*/REPORT.md -> 20 of 50. 10 reports declare a root alias (M/, masters/, <masters>) in free prose.

body:
## Summary
After a red unit run an agent gets one line per failure, and for engine errors that line has no cause ('Unexpected Errors:'). Turn the red summary into a triage block per failure: the real cause lines, a verdict on whether the agent's own diff reaches the test, the flake history, and a paste-ready rerun command. Add `--failed` to re-run exactly the last failures.

## Description
junit.mjs keeps the full failure text and exposes `cause` (GUT's numbered error lines). The new triage.mjs (a) slices unit-tests.log by GUT's own 'res://file' / '* test_name' headers to attach the engine ERROR + at: + first backtrace frame for that test; (b) runs test_map over the same changed files `--changed` uses and prints REACHED by <path> / UNREACHED / PARSE; (c) reads the flake ledger for that test; (d) builds the rerun command. run_unit writes build/test-results/unit-triage.json (gtai.unit-triage/1) for agents to read instead of grepping the log. `--failed` reads the previous junit and runs only the failing files with the failing test name.

## Flow
- today: FAIL line -> open the 205 KB log -> find '* test_name' -> read the ERROR under it -> git diff and guess whether it is mine -> hand-write --select/--test -> re-run
- after: read one block (cause, REACHED/UNREACHED, flaked Nx, rerun cmd) -> `run_unit --failed`

## Expected impact
A red run's diagnosis goes from ~5 manual steps to reading one block. The 'is this mine?' call stops being blind: the runner already holds the diff-to-test map. Agents get a machine-readable triage file instead of log greps.

## Evaluation
Claim: the runner's red output carries the cause and the mine-or-not signal it already has the data for.
Before: for an engine-error failure the digest message is 'Unexpected Errors:' (0 cause lines). Diagnosis needs the 5,321-line / 205 KB build/test-results/unit-tests.log, and no mode re-runs the last failures. Measured on the current log: the save test's engine ERROR sits 1 line under its '* test_unwritable_profile_reports_and_does_not_throw' header, so it can be attributed.
After: the same failure prints its error lines inline plus a verdict and a rerun command; `--failed` re-runs it in one command.
Method: probe - read junit.mjs:26 against gut.gd:625/error_tracker.gd:157 (cause on line 2+); grepped the live unit-tests.log for per-test headers ('res://...' then '* test_') and ERROR placement (lines 1766-1771, 4374-4379).
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: junit.mjs:26 `c.message = text.split('\n')[0].trim()`; gut.gd:625 `script_inst._fail(str("Unexpected Errors:\n", error_tracker.get_fail_text_for_errors(test_id)))`; error_tracker.gd:157 `error_texts.append(str('<', error.get_error_type_name(), '>', error.code))`. build/test-results/unit-tests.log: 5321 lines, sections '===== import (exit 0, 33.6 s)', '===== gut (exit 0, 53.5 s)'; per-file header line 1766 'res://tests/unit/test_aim_reach.gd' then '* test_...' lines; line 4376-4378 '* test_unwritable_profile_reports_and_does_not_throw' / 'ERROR: Could not create directory ...' / 'at: make_dir_recursive'. Lane cost: docs/day/2026-11-07/vehicles/JOURNAL.md:284-285 (6 FAILED 'Unexpected Errors', cause found by hand); docs/night/2026-11-05/look/JOURNAL.md:306 and docs/night/2026-11-05/ranged/JOURNAL.md:1915 (known-flake judgement made from memory, re-ran the whole suite). Flake ledger today: 2 entries (`node tools/tests/flakes.mjs report --min=2`).
